purpose: Teach: 鉄砲/小作/扮/バルブ/チタン/引き寄せ/押し上げ/小国

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 歴史的に、本気で、絶対、鉄砲、絶対、技術、絶対、模型作り、絶対、当社、絶対、研究しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to take this seriously. Research our company's work in historical firearms technology and model-making. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured pace. Each phrase lands with expectation. No softness. Leaning forward slightly, eyes sharp.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方の、本気で、絶対、小作、絶対、農家、絶対、当社、絶対、提携、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward on partnership with local tenant farmers. Thank you for the opportunity to contribute.
lines.style: Respectful and earnest. Steady tempo, each update delivered with quiet confidence. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: CMで俳優が、本気で、絶対、扮、絶対、する、絶対、役柄、絶対、当社、絶対、慎重に、絶対、選定しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: For the commercial, I want you to be very careful about which roles the actors play. This matters. Choose wisely.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Slight pause before 'choose wisely'—this is the crux. Tone is instructive but not harsh. Assumes competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の、本気で、絶対、バルブ、絶対、最新型、絶対、導入、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're rolling out the latest valve systems for the factory expansion. Progress is steady.
lines.style: Crisp status report. Businesslike but not rushed. A hint of satisfaction in the delivery—things are moving as planned. Eyes on the horizon.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品に、本気で、絶対、チタン、絶対、素材、絶対、採用しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The new product line needs titanium components. Make it happen.
lines.style: Direct and final. No room for negotiation in the tone. Quick, sharp delivery on the decision. Settled back slightly—expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様を、本気で、絶対、引き寄せる、絶対、キャンペーン、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We have a customer attraction campaign underway. The momentum is building.
lines.style: Confident update with a hint of anticipation. Slightly faster pace than previous response—there's energy here. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績を、本気で、絶対、押し上げる、絶対、新戦略、絶対、必要だ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need a new strategy to drive performance up. This is essential.
lines.style: Weighty and emphatic. Slow on 'essential'—it lands like a gavel. Tone brooks no argument. Direct eye contact held steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外、本気で、絶対、小国、絶対、市場、絶対、当社、絶対、進出、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're currently evaluating our market entry into smaller overseas territories. The groundwork is in place.
lines.style: Methodical and thorough. Slightly longer pacing to show careful consideration. A sense of deliberation—this isn't rushed. Respectful close.
